messages:
maria: Alert: after maintenance window were seeing SSO decrypt failures and SCIM deprovision flapping. Need triage.

sanjay: Samples? IdPs?

maria: Azure AD + Okta. authproxy shows: 
```
2026-03-23T01:55:03Z authproxy ERROR saml: decryptAssertion: KMSDecryptFailed: InvalidCiphertextException user=acct-xyz extid=U:abcd1234
```

jen: Sounds like encryption context or key version mismatch. Ops did a rolling rewrap ~01:40?

maria: Correct. Also an RBAC rename happened (org:admin -> org:admin_v2) in same window. ops-bot shows deploy.

ops-bot: deploy/redwood-identity-2026-03-23 completed by @ops at 01:42 UTC

dmitri: Two simultaneous changes likely broke audit correlation. If assertion fails to decrypt, deprov worker can mark stale without emitting audit entries (known bug).

maria: Auditstore shows missing deprov events for affected extids.

sanjay: Immediate: pause SCIM queue, halt any further rewraps, attempt alias remap to previous KMS version, run dry-run replays for audit backfill.

sec-oncall: Oncall executing: pausing queue and opening incident. Also verify no permissive fallback path that could cause elevation.

ops-bot: Queue/scim-deprov paused by @ops at 02:03 UTC

maria: KMS metadata: LastRewrap 2026-03-23T01:41:12Z, EncryptionContext {"env":"prod","service":"authproxy","wrap_id":"wrap-20260323-01"}. Old wrap_id was wrap-20260322-99.

dmitri: That explains InvalidCiphertextException. Can we remap alias to the old key version?

maria: Old key version v23 still exists and is not scheduled for deletion. I can remap alias back if approved.

sanjay: Approve temporary remap. Also add temporary compatibility for old role name to avoid 403s from cached sessions.

jen: Compliance: collect list of deprovs between 01:40-02:10, backfill audits after rollback, and notify customers. Fix the deprov worker bug so parse failures always emit an audit event.

sec-oncall: SEV-2 INC-2026-0423 opened. Owners: ops=rollback, eng-identity=shim & tests, security=audit/backfill + vuln triage.

maria: Remapped alias to v23 at 02:22 UTC; sample decrypts succeed. Dry-run shows 18 deprov events missing that we can backfill. Holding before state changes.

dmitri: Add integration tests covering KMS rewrap + SDK versions + RBAC rename cache behavior to prevent regression.

jen: Patch: on assertion parse failure -> emit AuditEvent type=deprov_failed reason=decrypt_error assertion_id=unknown extid=provided. Add unit + e2e tests.

maria: I'll run backfill and draft customer timeline/RCA. Will update. :phone: 

ops-bot: incident/INC-2026-0423 created and paging oncall.
